settings.heading:
A bed that becomes yours,
and stays that way.
settings.lede: Emperor is 200 by 200 centimetres. Twenty wider than a Super King, and the largest size that still takes bedding you can buy anywhere. Made to order, and tailored to your feel after you have slept on it.

settings.heading: Every size we make
settings.lede: All made to order. All 35cm deep. All with the same replaceable comfort layer.
settings.table_note: European King fits IKEA and most continental bed frames.

settings.heading: Why it is 200 wide
settings.body:
Emperor gives each sleeper a full metre. A Super King gives ninety centimetres, which is the width of a single bed. For two adults, one of whom moves, the difference is a night uninterrupted.

It is also the largest size that still takes bedding you can buy anywhere, and the largest most rooms will hold without the room becoming a bed with walls around it.
settings.body_2: We make to order, so the size exists because someone wants it, not because a machine was already set up for it.

settings.label: Core
settings.text: Pocket springs. Twenty five year guarantee.

settings.label: Comfort layer
settings.text: Removable and reversible. Two feels. You do not choose. It arrives with both.

settings.label: Comfort layer, later
settings.text: [layer] when it eventually softens, instead of [price].

settings.heading: Built in two parts
settings.lede: A mattress does not wear out. The top ten centimetres wear out. Ours separates. A pocket sprung core built to last twenty five years, and a comfort layer above it that unzips and lifts off.
settings.promise_body: If the feel is not right, we send the layer that takes you there, and you keep it, with our compliments. Worth [layer]. Emperor is made to order at 200 x 200cm and is not covered by the 30-day return trial. Your statutory cancellation rights are unaffected.

settings.heading: You do not choose the feel. You discover it.
settings.text: Feel is discovered over months of use. You have a year with us. We adjust it until it is.

settings.heading: It arrives finished.
settings.text: Concierged. Room of your choice. Unrolled onto your bed. The old one leaves with it.

settings.heading: It stays right for twenty five years.
settings.text: The part that softens renews. The part that lasts, lasts.

Concierge unpacking
settings.text: Concierged. Room of your choice. Unboxed, unrolled, positioned. The packaging leaves with it. So does the old one.

settings.heading: Old mattress removal and recycling
settings.text: Taken away on the same visit. Nothing in the hall, nothing to arrange.

settings.heading: Nothing left behind
settings.text: Carton, plastic, wrap. All of it leaves with it.

settings.heading:
It arrives compressed.
We do not leave it that way.
settings.lede: Roll packing gets it up the stairs. It is not how it should be left.

settings.heading: Choose your size
settings.lede: You cannot know how a mattress feels in four minutes. So the feel is decided after a year, not before. Same 35cm construction, same removable comfort layer.
